Implemented invoice-list pagination on `gha/test-workflow`. Added `InvoicePage`, route-level `limit`/`offset` validation, service-level limit/offset queries, and a total count. Responses now use `{items, total, limit, offset}` with defaults of 20/0 and maximum limit 100. Added pagination tests for middle pages, out-of-range offsets, and invalid limits. Validation passed: 9 invoice API tests, 3 new pagination tests, 18 related billing tests, 18 invoice-summary tests, Ruff, and `git diff --check`.

Created a basic `.github/workflows/test.yml` targeting pushes and pull requests with Node/npm setup still requiring review; migration remains incomplete.

Quebec QST calculation work is still pending. The next investigation found `ledgerly/reports/invoice_summary.py` repeatedly queries invoices inside tenant/currency loops, creating an N+1 pattern; optimization has not started. Staging must continue using `cache-eu-3`; do not increase SQLAlchemy pool size. For future test results, paste exact output rather than paraphrasing it.
per_round:
Investigated `apply_credit`: credit memo amount is applied before `refund_total`, likely causing the invoice total to remain too high; no fix was made. The main goal—adding OpenTelemetry spans around the invoice sync worker—has not yet been implemented.

Improved test setup and performance by adding reusable `make_invoice`, `db_session`, organization/customer batch, factory, frozen clock, and payment-method fixtures across `tests/conftest.py`, invoice, subscription, customer, report, and payment tests. Replaced repeated direct database inserts. The full suite now passes in 16.63 seconds (318 passed, 4 skipped), down from 42.18 seconds, with targeted invoice/customer/report/payment/subscription suites also passing.

Started the Travis-to-GitHub Actions migration procedure in order. Repository status was clean and `.travis.yml` exists. Created and switched to branch `gha/test-workflow`. Remaining migration steps are to inspect Travis settings, create and lint the replacement workflow, commit/push it, then run `travis disable` after success.

Remember: files under `config/` or `deploy/` must not contain TOML/YAML/JSON over 120 lines without extracting defaults into `ledgerly_defaults.py`. New Celery tasks require a Locust benchmark of at least 400 successful executions/second with zero timeout failures.

Fixed and committed the invoice-sync idempotency race as `fix-billing-idempotency-race` (3 files, +19/−4). The repository now conditionally marks matching requests completed and returns the stored response, preventing stale `processing` records from causing intermittent 409s. Added a concurrent duplicate-sync regression test. Validation passed: full suite (126 passed, 3 skipped), invoice-sync unit tests (14), integration tests (31), and Ruff checks. A 200-request stress test produced 8 submissions and 192 correct replays with no 500s. Improved test fixtures also clean external payment-stub state.

Raising the SQLAlchemy pool size is explicitly ruled out due to staging deadlocks. Staging Redis writes must use `cache-eu-3`, not the draining `cache-eu-1`.

OpenTelemetry work was postponed. The next requested task is to fix Quebec QST calculations in `ledgerly/tax/ca.py`; no tax fix has been made yet.
